description: Use this when the user claims a domain is theirs and you are about to act on that claim. Ownership asserted in chat is not ownership; this is how it gets proven. Prove the user owns a domain via a DNS TXT challenge. action 'start' returns the TXT record to publish; action 'check' verifies it. Verification is required before a domain appears in list_domains. A failed DNS lookup returns an error, never 'not owned'.
name: verify_ownership
